description: Line items within an order — one row per product per order. This table has no tenant_id of its own; it is scoped transitively through orders.tenant_id via the order_id join. Flag for Phase 3: the AST guardrail needs a rule for tables scoped transitively through a joined parent, not just tables with their own tenant_id column.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: The order this line item belongs to

columns.name: unit_price_cents
columns.description: Price per unit at time of purchase, in cents

ddl:
CREATE TABLE text_to_sql_node.order_items (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  order_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES text_to_sql_node.orders(id),
  product_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES text_to_sql_node.products(id),
  quantity INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unit_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL
);
